global: A bowl of spicy ramen with rich, vibrant orange broth. Topped with chashu pork, bean sprouts, and green garnish, it sits in a patterned bowl on a tray, under soft, even lighting that highlights the steamy, appetizing dish.

regions.background: Light beige tray with smooth, slightly glossy surface and faint, subtle texture, oval-shaped with rounded edges.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a light blue rim, white base with gray floral pattern, and a pink flower design.
regions.soup: Spicy ramen broth with noodles, bean sprouts, and green garnish, swirling in rich orange-red liquid.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice, browned and tender, rests atop noodles, garnished with sprouts and green onions.
